facts.name: K. Mark Johnson
facts.assignment: Official profile: Divisions 25 — Drug Court and 63 — County Civil, Putnam County. Procedure calendar also lists small claims, traffic, truancy, delinquency, Marchman Act and Baker Act matters; no exhaustive noncivil review.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Counsel email the JA with case number, name and subject; copy all parties. Self-represented communications go in writing through the clerk.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Counsel request time by JA email; self-represented parties submit written requests through clerk. Send filed notice to JA to reserve time. Notify JA promptly of cancellation.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Consult other participants about scheduling; proposed-order email states agreement. General conduct section requests good-faith resolution of discovery disputes; no motion-specific analysis.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: File through the clerk; deliver hearing materials at least three business days before the hearing. Consult linked procedures for details.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email Word orders to JA within three days after hearing and state whether parties agree to content.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Email, mail or hand delivery; PDF/A or Word preferred electronically. More than25pages requires paper. Deliver at least three business days before evidentiary proceedings.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Civil/small-claims pretrial conferences may use Zoom; evidentiary hearings and trials require in-person appearance. Obtain meeting ID from JA. Preserve the source’s awkward “without leaving the court” wording without inferred correction.

facts.review_scope: Profile contacts/assignment and nine-page procedure PDF collected. Substantive review limited to sections A–E, general scheduling/conferral language in H/L and court-reporter operating note in J. Specialized motions, trial recipes, criminal forms and detailed noncivil matters not analyzed. Page1 visually inspected.
facts.summary: County civil scheduling and submissions use JA email; proposed orders are Word documents. Linked procedures distinguish remote pretrial conferences from in-person evidentiary hearings/trials. County civil proceedings generally are not recorded; parties seeking a record provide a reporter.

SectionB directs hearing requests to JA; sectionH separately refers to an online scheduling platform for approved conferences without identifying a platform URL. Both directions retained.
